name: Project summary
pitch: Make a one-page summary of current projects for a stakeholder update.
instructions: Start by listing the project files in the workspace. Read each file and extract the project name, status, next step and owner. If a file cannot be read, note that it was skipped. When all files are read, make a single page that lists each project as a row with its name, status, next step and owner. If no project files are found, say so and offer to list the inbox instead. Show the finished page to the person and ask if they want to save it or make changes.

examples.does: list project files, read them and make a one-page table of name, status, next step and owner

skills.name: extract-project-details
skills.description: Read each project file and pull out its name, status, next step and owner.
skills.body: 1. Open the file. 2. Look for a heading or label that gives the project name. 3. Find the line that says 'status' or 'state'. 4. Find the line that says 'next step' or 'action'. 5. Find the line that says 'owner' or 'responsible'. 6. Write those four items on one line. 7. Close the file and move to the next one.

readme:
# Project summary
Create a one-page summary of current projects for a stakeholder update.

What it does: reads project files from the workspace, extracts name, status, next step and owner, and makes a table on a single page.

What it needs: file_read to open files, make_page to create the output, show_table to display the table.

What it will not do: it cannot read files that do not exist or do not contain the expected headings.
